audit_items.title: Can Withdrawal struct fields be modified after freeze operation?
audit_items.rationale: The slotted_freezable pattern and freeze semantics are EL Python execution spec concepts. In Prysm CL, Withdrawal is a protobuf struct (proto/engine/v1/electra.pb.go) without freeze semantics. Protobuf structs in Go are mutable by design; immutability is not enforced at the CL layer. The EL-side freeze pattern does not apply.

code_scope.resolution: Prysm has WithdrawalRequest as protobuf (proto/engine/v1/electra.pb.go:25) but no slotted_freezable or freeze semantics. This is an EL execution spec concept.
